join_order.notes: Use pre_join.idx for existence-only probe; no rowids needed for anti-join

data_structures.anti_join_index: pre_built_hash_multimap(pre_join.idx, mmap read-only, existence probe only via hash_u32x3)
data_structures.aggregation: per_thread_hash_map<uint64_t, AggState> where key = (tag_code << 32 | version_code), AggState = {int64_t count, double sum}
data_structures.aggregation_sizing: ~20000 groups per thread, fits in L1/L2 cache

parallelism.notes: Each thread: scan morsel → apply 3 filters → probe anti-join index → aggregate into thread-local hash map. Merge thread-local maps after all morsels consumed.

indexes.probe_method: hash_u32x3(adsh, tag, version) → linear probe → if no occupied slot with matching key_hash before empty slot, row qualifies

mmap_strategy.advice: MADV_SEQUENTIAL + MADV_HUGEPAGE on all num columns
mmap_strategy.raii_scoping: declare MMap objects at outer scope before RAII timer to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost

scan_loop.description: Fused scan: apply all 3 filters first (cheapest first: uom uint16 eq, value_null uint8 eq, ddate int32 range), then probe anti-join index, then aggregate survivors
filter_order: uom == usd_code (uint16_t, most selective per byte)
ddate BETWEEN lower AND upper (int32_t, range)
scan_loop.anti_join_probe: hash_u32x3(adsh, tag, version) → linear probe pre_join hash table → qualify if NOT found

aggregation.merge: single-threaded merge of thread-local maps (small: ~20K entries each)

output.decode: lookup tag and version strings from dictionaries
